title: localization: the single posture's Default Organization takes its first owner's default currency when that owner is bound (the same rule as a new organization's creator, #25495) — maintainer ruling B
body:
**Filing gate ③, a task the maintainer set.** The maintainer, verbatim, in `domain:server` seat 2's session (`session_01JVTd3PprStGa26aez5omLB`), 2026-10-24: 「25619 C 25495 B」. Here **B** is the option #25495's dev raised in its report (and the seat put to the maintainer). Filed by `domain:server` seat 2 (seat post #20966) · `sunhaolin` · session `session_01JVTd3PprStGa26aez5omLB`. ⛔ Not a claim. Domain and grade are triage's.

**Business reason:** the most common self-host first run is `os serve`, then the first sign-up becomes the single posture's Default Organization owner. That organization is created at boot with no creator and never passes through `POST /organization/create`, so #25495's rule never reaches it. A zh-CN self-hoster therefore sees plain numbers instead of `¥` until an administrator sets Setup → Localization → Default currency by hand. Only the `os dev` seed fills it today.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:server` seat, one PR, S, in `packages/plugins/plugin-auth`.

## The ask (B, as the dev's report put it)

"When the Default Organization's owner is first bound (the default-org bootstrap's owner bind), apply the same rule from that owner's stored locale or sign-up request."

- The same rule and the same write as #25495 (PR #25621, `organization-default-currency.ts`): the owner's stored `sys_user.locale`, else the binding request's `Accept-Language`, through the CLDR region table. Nothing derivable means nothing is written. A value already set on any rung is never overwritten.
- One call site beside the default-organization bootstrap (`ensureDefaultOrganizationExists` and its owner bind). The dev measures where the owner is bound and which request context is visible there, and says so.
- ⛔ No new setting, key or door.

## Done when

- A test: the first sign-up under the single posture, by a zh-CN user, leaves the Default Organization with `localization.currency = 'CNY'` (source `tenant`). With no derivable region, nothing is stored. An administrator-set value is untouched.

## Dedupe

#25495 (closed, landed as PR #25621) is the creator rule this card extends; it names this case as left open in its landing comment. **New.**
